caption: the luxor follow-up - same rolling chains, sharper difficulty and a shrine of new power balls.
about: Luxor: Amun Rising (2005) is the direct sequel to the original marble line: same winged shooter, same rolling chains, new temple tracks tuned harder and a wider spread of power balls to earn. It is the bridge chapter between the first game's rules and luxor 2's rebuild - the formula at its purest, before the series started adding systems.
The steam listing still sells the pc build, which makes this the one luxor chapter with a live official door alongside luxor 2 and luxor 3.
